description: This Kotlin file defines the HomeFragment class which displays a grid of smart home devices, including setup of the RecyclerView, sample device data, and UI interactions.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A fragment responsible for displaying and managing a grid of smart home devices.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and sets up device data and RecyclerView.

methods.name: setupDevices
methods.description: Creates a list of sample devices and updates the device count display.

methods.name: setupRecyclerView
methods.description: Configures the RecyclerView with a grid layout and adapter.

methods.name: updateDeviceState
methods.description: Handles toggling the device state on user interaction.
